t: The tall granite obelisk in front of you is Speke's Monument, in Kensington Gardens. It is Grade II listed. It commemorates John Hanning Speke, an army officer and explorer who made three expeditions to Africa. He is often credited with discovering Lake Victoria and the source of the Nile, and with Richard Burton he was the first European to reach the lake. The monument was designed by Philip Hardwick, an architect best known for the demolished Euston Arch.
